info.title: Ricarut Developer API (Phase 2)
info.description: Unified financial infrastructure platform providing identity, organizations, project environments, and secure API keys management.

post.description: Registers a new developer profile, hashes credentials, automatically creates a default business organization, and grants owner permissions.

201.description: Account and default organization successfully created

post.description: Verifies developer credentials and signs a new dashboard session JWT token.
Clears active session tracking (client discards stateless JWT; creates system logout audit trail).

get.description: Returns current authenticated developer user profile details and corresponding organization role memberships.

post.description: Creates a manual business entity organization, setting the creator as owner.

get.description: Lists organizations the authenticated user belongs to.
Returns settings for a singular organization user is a member of.

patch.description: Updates settings. Gated to Owner or Admin roles.

post.description: Registers a project inside an organization. Gated by Owner, Admin, or Developer roles.

get.description: Returns authorized projects across user memberships, optionally filtered by organizationId.

post.description: Generates a secure API key for the project. Plaintext keys are shown exactly **once** in this response payload. Gated by Owner, Admin, or Developer roles.

get.description: Lists existing API keys with secrets redacted (prefixes only shown).

delete.description: Revokes an API key instantly, disabling it from subsequent authentications while preserving an audit trail. Gated by Owner, Admin, or Developer roles.

post.description: Creates a new customer context inside the active project. Standard dual authentication (user session or API key) is supported.

get.description: Lists customers in the current project context.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Explicit project identifier (required for standard session auth, ignored for API keys)

get.description: Gets full information of a customer matching the specified ID.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Explicit project identifier (required for standard session auth, ignored for API keys)

patch.description: Modifies specified fields of a customer.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Explicit project identifier (required for standard session auth, ignored for API keys)

post.description: Creates a financial account context for a validated customer.

get.description: Lists financial accounts matching query filters.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Explicit project identifier (required for standard session auth, ignored for API keys)

get.description: Gets details of an account by its ID.

patch.description: Updates account parameters like name and lifecycle status with rules validation.

400.description: Invalid account status transitions or validation rules failed

post.description: Performs an atomic, double-entry financial transfer between two Ricarut accounts. Amounts use minor units (e.g., NGN 1000000 = ₦10,000). Requires an Idempotency-Key header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key to enforce idempotent execution

400.description: Insufficient funds, currency mismatch, inactive account, or invalid details

409.description: Idempotency conflict or reference already exists

get.description: Calculates the dynamic available balance derived directly from ledger entry history.
Lists cursor-paginated ledger entries for the specified account in reverse chronological order.
Returns a detailed Journal record containing nested double-entry lines.

post.description: Atomic reversal of a posted ledger journal, creating inverse entries to safely restore balances.

400.description: Transaction is already reversed or insufficient funds to debit the reversal

post.description: Initiates an internal wallet transfer or an external payout through a routed provider.
Processes incoming callbacks signed cryptographically by external providers.

role.description: Authenticated user's role in this organization

key.description: PLAINTEXT API key. Will never be displayed again after creation.

keyPrefix.description: Safe, redacted identifier for developers to recognize which key is utilized

ForbiddenError.description: Action is prohibited or resource is out of bounds

ConflictError.description: Resource duplicates or business conflicts prevent completion

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limiting triggers, blocking traffic temporarily
